nate: Heads-up — planning a soft-unpin rollout for runtime-2.15 in eu-west tonight at 23:30 UTC. Keeping a small safelist for known sticky combos; proposed exceptions posted below.

amanda: Do we have a single-source list of pinned models/SDKs to preserve for Dedicated customers? Want to avoid surprise reinstates.

deploybot: [deploybot] Proposed pinlist diff (preview): ```diff
--- pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.14)
+++ pinlist/runtime.yaml (v2.15)
@@
-  - model: gpt3a-legacy
-    reason: longseq kv-cache incompat
+  # removed gpt3a-legacy — compatibility validated in staging
+  - model: llama3q-quant
+    reason: reserved-for-eu-dedicated
```

sophie: Rollback/abort criteria suggestion: p50 latency increase >10% sustained for 10m OR error-rate spike >3% for 5m. Automatic fallback to runtime-2.14 should be configured for canary. Agree?

eric: Do we have longseq perf telemetry for llama3q in eu-west canary? If not, add 1h warmup and capture baseline before ramp.

lina: Ill set the canary cohort: 1% traffic for 30m, then 5% for 60m if stable. Smoke tests in the checklist: embeddings, chat-sanity, and 4k-token longseq.

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Ill monitor infra dashboards and keep the pager rotation updated. If thresholds hit, Ill start the manual rollback runbook.

nate: Quick rollback commands (if needed):
```bash
# force rollback to pinned runtime
deploybot rollback --env eu-west --runtime 2.14 --reason "post-unpin regression"
# reapply model pin quickly
deploybot pin add --env eu-west --model gpt3a-legacy --note "re-pin on regression"
```

amanda: Add SDK compatibility gate: SDK v3.5 must pass smoke suite against runtime-2.15 before global pin lift. @eric can you own this?

eric: Ill run the SDK smoke suite at 22:45 UTC and post results (tokenization checks + sample convo traces).

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist staged. Please react with :thumbsup: to approve or :x: to request hold. Change will apply at 23:30 UTC if >=2 approvals.

sophie: I'll add automated anomaly alerts (p50/p95) and a regression eval that runs on the canary prompt set every 5 minutes.

nate: Approved. Kicking off at 23:30. If anything odd, ping this thread and tag sre-oncall + deploybot. Short window tonight; well revert fast if thresholds trip.
